title: zazzle-git component diagram
description: The zazzle-git crate: one library in src/ behind three thin binaries, its end-to-end tests, the zazzle invoker that execs it for `zazzle git`, the git it runs and hands everything else to, and the optional agent CLIs that compose a default commit message.

components.name: zazzle-git
components.responsibility: The package and its three binaries: zazzle-git, zazzle-git-commit and zazzle-git-commit-message-editor.

components.name: zazzle-git sources
components.responsibility: Routing, the commit flow, the message editor, its terminal, git access and the agent that composes a default commit message; src/bin holds the three entry points.

components.name: Pseudo-terminal tests
components.responsibility: Run the built binaries on a pseudo-terminal in scratch repositories and type keys into them: saving and cancelling a message, commits with marks, the deletion prompt, a failing hook, amend, a first commit, an interactive rebase, and agent-composed messages with stand-in claude, codex and gemini scripts first on PATH.

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: Execs the zazzle-git beside itself for `zazzle git ARGS`.

components.name: git
components.responsibility: The real git on PATH: status, config, rev-parse, add, rm, reset and commit for the commit flow, and every command zazzle git does not answer itself.

components.name: Agent CLIs
components.responsibility: claude, codex or gemini on PATH, optional: run without tools to compose a default commit message.

relationships.description: Built into the library and the three binaries.
cargo test runs them against the built binaries.
Execs the zazzle-git binary from its own directory.
Runs git captured with a timeout, attached to the terminal for commit, or replaces itself with it (git.rs).
Runs the chosen one in the background with the prompt on stdin (compose.rs), when one is installed.
Builds scratch repositories and runs git rebase -i with the editor as sequence editor.
